metadata.title: [Kernel][SM70] GLM-5.3: FP32-softmax sparse MLA for FP8-KV decode/verify
metadata.body:
## Purpose

For FP8 (packed E4M3) KV, GLM-5.3-Flash decode and speculative verify (1-8 tokens) run `sm70_glm5_sparse_attention_paged_fp8_gemm` / `_batched_gemm`. Both gather and dequantize the selected latents, then write raw, unscaled QK^T scores into fp16 buffers before the softmax. Storing raw scores in fp16 costs precision at moderate logits, and once a raw score passes the fp16 range the output is wrong but still finite. This is the same class as #210, #219 and #905 for the XQA and grouped routes.

## Change

- New op `sm70_glm53_sparse_mla_fp8_out` (`csrc/sm70_turbomind/ops/glm53_sparse_mla_fp8_sm70.cu`, registered in `_C` next to `sm70_glm53_fp16_gemv_out`). One CTA handles 16 query heads of one token for one split of the selected keys:
  - dequantization bit-exact with the existing gather;
  - QK^T and PV on tensor cores with FP32 accumulation;
  - scores scaled in FP32 and never stored in fp16, FP32 online softmax with exact running maxima;
  - FP32 log-sum-exp combine across splits.
  It allocates nothing and does not sync, so it is CUDA-graph capturable. The numerical contract and admission rules are in the file header.
- `vllm/models/glm5next/sm70/sparse.py` uses it for every FP8-KV call of up to 8 tokens when heads per rank are a multiple of 16 (16 at TP4). Split count follows the token count (about 64 CTAs per head group).
- The GEMM routes stay only as the fallback for other head counts, with a warning at startup. Their fp16 workspaces are reserved only in that case. Prefill (more than 8 tokens) is unchanged; it already keeps FP32 softmax state.
- No environment variable and no new knob. The startup route log names the path.

## Not a duplicate

No open or closed PR changes the GLM-5.3 FP8-KV decode/verify path (searched: "sparse MLA", "glm5next sparse", "FP8 KV decode GLM", "fp32 softmax"). #171/#816 target DeepSeek-V4 sparse MLA, not this backend.

## Test Plan

- Kernel vs an FP64 reference over an independent dequantization of a cache packed by the real `sm70_glm5_fp8_kv_insert`: T in {1, 2, 5, 8}, 16 and 32 heads, 1, 3 and heuristic splits, skipped (-1) indices, partial and empty rows.
- Raw scores past the fp16 range: the real GEMM route vs the new op against the FP64 reference.
- CUDA-graph replay vs eager.
- Mutation check: storing scores in fp16, and dropping the split rescale, must fail the suite.
- The existing `tests/models/glm5next/test_sm70_sparse.py` must still pass.
- E2E on 4x V100-SXM2-32GB TP4: route log, greedy identity vs the GEMM route, gsm8k / factual / fabrication battery, 84K needle, decode speed.

## Test Result

Operator results on one V100-SXM2-32GB, not model throughput:

- `pytest tests/models/glm5next/test_sm70_sparse.py`: 36 passed (10 existing + 26 new).
- Mutations: fp16 score storage fails 1 test; a broken split combine fails 17.
- Relative L2 error vs FP64 at 16 heads, T=1:

  | max raw score | new op | GEMM route |
  |---:|---:|---:|
  | 24 | 2.5e-4 | 3.5e-4 |
  | 2,424 | 9.4e-5 | 1.3e-3 |
  | 14,546 | 4.8e-5 | 5.8e-5 |
  | 96,966 | 1e-15 | 0.93 (wrong, finite) |

- Latency at 16 heads, 2048 selected keys: T=1 46 us vs 121 us for the GEMM route; T=4 87 us; T=8 161 us.
- Graph replay matches eager bitwise.
- pre-commit: all hooks pass, including clang-format. Layering ratchet: no growth.
- E2E: pending, results will be attached in a comment.

We have not seen raw scores past the fp16 range in real GLM-5.3 traffic. The overflow is a latent hazard; the measured gains are precision at moderate logits and per-call latency.

Gates before review:

- [x] Kernel reference, overflow, graph and mutation tests
- [x] Existing GLM sparse tests
- [x] pre-commit and layering ratchet
- [ ] Full CMake build of `_C` with the new op
- [ ] E2E route, greedy identity, quality battery and long context on 4x V100 TP4
- [ ] E2E on `LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4` @ `9e0d74e3` (8x V100, TP4/PP2)

## AI assistance

This change was developed with AI assistance (Claude). The submitting human (@philbert440) is accountable for it and reviews every changed line before this leaves draft.

nodes.body:
### Rebased on current `main` (4e5357b59)

`main` reorganized `vllm/_sm70_ops.py` into a re-export shim over `vllm/_sm70/*` (c9d825d5c), which made this branch stop merging. The commit is replayed on top of that as `587fac6eb`: the `sm70_glm53_sparse_mla_fp8_out` wrapper and its fake now live in `vllm/_sm70/auxiliary.py` and are exported from the shim; nothing else changed.

Ancestry audit verified this live head 587fac6eb37b8aee1cd42df76f4af284d30f503d is retained in #1125 at da13d2d9ca4bba2cf7757442afde63c38b407d78. Closing this earlier stack entry as superseded and tracking review/validation in #1125; source commits, authorship and the original discussion remain intact. This closure is not a main merge and does not qualify outstanding hardware/model/quality cases. Audit assisted by Codex.
